title: Finite clopen preparation of constant finite free residue cohomology
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and residue field $k=R/(\varpi)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $S$ be an affine weakly contractible scheme for its small pro-etale site [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], meaning that evaluation on $S$ sends every epimorphism of sheaves of sets to a surjection. For each open subscheme $U\subseteq S$, put $B_U=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/\varpi^n)_U$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_S))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that $K$ is derived complete for its quotient tower, meaning that the quotient maps exhibit $K$ as a derived limit of $(K\otimes^L_{B_S}(R/\varpi^n)_S)_{n\geq1}$, with its canonical reduction transitions and all terms viewed in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_S))$ by restriction of scalars [def-weil-derived-limit, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Assume also that its derived residue reduction $K_1=K\otimes^L_{B_S}k_S$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] has locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] constructible cohomology sheaves (locally constant with finite-dimensional $k$-module local models) with only finitely many nonzero degrees [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and has finite global Tor amplitude: there are integers $a\leq b$ such that for every $k_S$-module sheaf $L$, the cohomology sheaves of $K_1\otimes^L_{k_S}L$ vanish outside $[a,b]$, with the resolution-tested tensor convention of [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude] [def-weil-derived-tensor, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Then there is a finite disjoint open cover of S such that every member is affine and weakly contractible; the integral derived pullback of K to it is complete, its residue has finite Tor amplitude, and each residue cohomology sheaf is isomorphic to a finite power of its residue coefficient sheaf. This asserts no integral projective complex model.

proof.text: Bounded constructibility leaves finitely many possibly nonzero residue cohomology sheaves. Choose a simultaneous pro-etale trivializing cover using finite base changes and compositions of covering families [det-pe-topos-functoriality-site]. Finite constructible stalks make the local constant residue modules finite-dimensional vector spaces. Apply [lem-sf-weakly-contractible-clopen-refinement] to this common covering, discarding empty pieces. Pull back the trivializations along its factorization maps, and choose bases to identify the constant vector-space sheaves with finite powers of the residue sheaf. In the vanishing degrees use rank zero.

On each clopen piece use [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Sheaves on S identify with pairs on that piece and its clopen complement; restriction is the projection, and extension by the terminal sheaf on the complement transports the section lifting condition, so the piece is weakly contractible. A clopen open in an affine scheme is affine. Projection on module sheaves is exact and preserves all limits, tensor products, quotient maps and Roos triangles. Hence the completed coefficient sheaf restricts to the local completed sheaf, derived completeness and residue Tor amplitude restrict, and completed integral pullback of a complete complex identifies with ordinary restriction with its residue cohomology. These assertions apply without any Noetherian hypothesis on S. The empty cover handles empty S.

theorem residue_clopen_preparation
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (hweak : (Scheme.ProEt.topology S).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 S)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E S))
    (hcomplete : IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S K)
    (hresidue : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) S
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf S
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules S (proEtaleConstantRing S
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))) q).obj
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)))
    (hTor : HasFiniteProEtaleTorAmplitude S
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → S.Opens),
      (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        IsAffine (U i).toScheme ∧
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U i).toScheme).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1}
          (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (U i).toScheme)) ∧
        IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme
          ((integralDerivedPullback l E (U i).ι).obj K) ∧
        HasFiniteProEtaleTorAmplitude (U i).toScheme
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme 0).obj
            ((integralDerivedPullback l E (U i).ι).obj K)) ∧
        ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ N : ℕ, Nonempty
          (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (proEtaleRingModules (U i).toScheme (proEtaleConstantRing (U i).toScheme
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))) q).obj
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme 0).obj
              ((integralDerivedPullback l E (U i).ι).obj K))) ≅
            ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (integralCoefficientSheaf.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme 0))
